verdict.rationale: Teller is a hosted bank-data API that users reach through Teller-issued mTLS certificates, and the evidence shows no self-hostable or open-source release of the core product. The only GitHub item is a client-side React Connect component, and one community member wishes the product were open source, which suggests it is not. Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS API, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
